page_title: AUG 1-1 UNI | Augsburg v Union Berlin 15/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Frederik Ronnow makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) after a cross from the side.
90+7' The corner from Mert Komur (Augsburg) is hurriedly cleared.

90+7' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Augsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+5' Augsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+5' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Augsburg win a corner.
90+4' A player from Union Berlin brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Augsburg will take a free kick near the side line.
90+2' 1 - 1 Goal! Andrej Ilic takes aim and his effort deflects off Marin Ljubicic (Union Berlin) to beat the goalkeeper. 1:1.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) takes out his opponent with a terrible tackle and is sent off by the referee!
89' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
88' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Union Berlin will take a corner.
84' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Union Berlin will take a free kick.
83' Alexis Claude-Maurice will be replaced by Fabian Rieder (Augsburg).
83' Substitution. Michael Gregoritsch makes his way off the pitch and Samuel Essende (Augsburg) comes on as his replacement.
82' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Diogo Leite and he is replaced by Marin Ljubicic (Union Berlin).
82' Substitution. Alex Kral (Union Berlin) in, Rani Khedira out.
81' Mert Komur (Augsburg) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z.
79' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
78' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) makes a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul. Union Berlin earn a free kick.

77' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
76' The attendance for today's match is 27267.
75' Manuel Baum has decided to make a change. Mert Komur (Augsburg) replaces Anton Kade.
75' Substitution. Dimitrios Giannoulis leaves the pitch and is replaced by Marius Wolf (Augsburg).

73' Poor challenge! Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) is penalised for tripping and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Union Berlin, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
71' The corner is floated into the centre of the box, but a placed header from Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) flies well wide of the right post.
71' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is about to take a corner kick.
70' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. Union Berlin have a corner.
68' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
67' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Livan Burcu (Union Berlin), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
67' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
65' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
64' A substitution has been made. Ilyas Ansah goes off and Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) comes on.
64' Substitution. Oliver Burke walks off the pitch and Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.
64' Here is a change. Andras Schafer is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin).
63' Elvis Rexhbecaj goes off the pitch and Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) comes on.

60' Anton Kade (Augsburg) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Frederik Ronnow blocks the shot with his legs.
59' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
58' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) fires in the free kick from a promising position just outside the box. It's a fantastic strike and looks set for glory, but it only rattles the right post!
57' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle. Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) commits a foul after dangerous play. Augsburg are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
57' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg).
54' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
53' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
52' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
52' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Florian Badstubner blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Union Berlin.
48' Florian Badstubner blows for a foul after Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Augsburg get a free kick.
46' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
46' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+6' 1 - 0 The ball rebounds a long way out to the feet of Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg), who immediately sends it back towards goal. He hits it extremely well. Frederik Ronnow is helpless against the projectile, which deflects in off the top of the right post. The score changes to 1:0.
45+6' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45+6' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
45+5' It looks like Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) saw red with that tackle. Florian Badstubner won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Augsburg are awarded the free kick.
45+5' Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
45+4' Corner kick. Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) is ready to send the ball into the box.
45+3' The game is interrupted now, Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

45+2' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Augsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+1' The free kick is taken by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg), but ball is cleared.
45+1' A player from Union Berlin commits a rough challenge. Florian Badstubner blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Augsburg have a free kick.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) tries to get on the end of a cross in a crowded box, but under pressure his header from near the penalty spot slips well wide of the right post.
44' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
43' The Union Berlin players are exchanging some short passes.
42' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Finn Dahmen comes off the line to clear the ball away.
39' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) takes the resultant free kick from distance and swings it into the box, but the goalkeeper climbs high to collect the ball.
39' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Union Berlin are awarded a free kick.

38' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Florian Badstubner blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Augsburg, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
36' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
33' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:1.
29' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the right post.
27' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
24' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Florian Badstubner saw the whole situation. Augsburg have been awarded a free kick.
22' A pass into the box finds Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Finn Dahmen denies him.
20' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) storms into the middle of the box and connects with a smart cross from Oliver Burke, the keeper is helpless but the header flies just over the bar.
17' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) attempts to find Oliver Burke with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
16' Referee Florian Badstubner sees the trip by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Augsburg in a dangerous position.
13' Neat link-up play between Anton Kade (Augsburg) and Alexis Claude-Maurice, but Frederik Ronnow reads the game well and the move breaks down.

12' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Oliver Burke, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
9' Half-chance! Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) plays a pass into the box, but Finn Dahmen reacts well to snuff out the attack.
7' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) commits a foul and Florian Badstubner immediately signals a free kick. Augsburg have a free kick.
5' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) tries to find Derrick Kohn, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
3' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) is able to continue to play.
2' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
1' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Florian Badstubner.
